guidance: When no existing organism or molecule fits, compose a Surface containing Badge, TerminalCard and Countdown; the walkthrough records this session preview. Surface supplies Material paint; respect each child's own treatment.

Reuse ListItem with its Body, Leading, Content and Meta parts for an agenda row; its own Surface recipe supplies the frame. Use a surrounding Surface only when a separate group frame is needed, not as a replacement for ListItem's treatment.

For a featured article link, reuse ArticleFeature and ArticleFeatureCover with PhotoFrame ratio=auto; ArticleFeature already uses the Surface raised frame. For a different passive media grouping, compose PhotoFrame and suitable content inside Surface rather than inventing a general card API.

Place a registration count as sibling content beside or after Hero in the host section, for example a labelled Stat; do not put it in Hero children, which accept zero to two independent named actions, or decorative media. Stat owns its own Material treatment and the consumer formats the value.
